newsitem.title: USA: Medtronic begins stent clinical evaluation.
newsitem.headline: Medtronic begins stent clinical evaluation.

text.p: Medtronic Inc said Tuesday it began the first human implants of the Medtronic VascuCoil peripheral vascular stent under an investigational device exemption granted by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
The device is being evaluated for use in the femoral arteries of the thigh and the popliteal artery behind the knee.

Peripheral vascular stents now cleared for commercial marketing in the United States are for use only in the large iliac arteries of the pelvic region. Medtronic estimates about 75,000 patients in the United States could benefit from a stent that could be used in the femoral or popliteal arteries.
